title: Changeset
description: Per-board changeset, applied by mendrik against an existing GitHub Projects v2 board (and Linear once plynth Linear support lands). Shape designed in Phase A1 against three real change-doc shapes: per-issue body amendments, multi-wave reconciliations, and tabular bulk backfills. See examples/ for sanitized synthetic fixtures covering each shape.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this document. 0.1.x is the first applier-consumable line; 0.0.1 (the Phase 0 stub) is deprecated and applier rejects it.

changeset_id.description: Stable identifier for this changeset within its board's repo. Lowercase, kebab-case. Used as the directory name under .mendrik/changesets/ and as the apply-report filename stem.

summary.description: Operator-facing prose. One paragraph, plain text. Surfaced in mendrik apply --dry-run output and in the apply report header.

modifications.description: Per-issue mutations that don't fit the bulk-table shape: title renames, body amendments, status changes paired with comments, decision cross-references.

new_tasks.description: Issues to create on the board. v0 caveat: mendrik delegates creation to plynth and emits these as pending_external_actions of target=plynth-create. Schema accepts them now so the changeset shape stabilizes; applier behavior catches up in v0.2.

field_updates.description: Flat {issue, field, value} bulk-table mutations. Suited to Phase B/C-style backfill where one row per issue+field is the natural form. Applier MUST apply field_options before field_updates so any new option values referenced here resolve.

field_options.description: Declarative full-desired-state for single-select field options (add new, rename, recolor). GraphQL updateProjectV2Field replaces the full options list, so applier MUST read current options, merge, write. Each entry under desired_options is the COMPLETE set for that field after apply; omitting an existing option deletes it (and its item values).

decisions.description: Decision-register entries surfacing from the changeset: things the operator is choosing between or has chosen. Distinct from modifications (which apply mutations) — decisions document context that other modifications may reference via decisions_resolved.

pending_external_actions.description: Out-of-band TODOs the applier cannot execute: doc-site updates, vendor follow-ups, inventory record-store updates, registry updates, new-issue creation (v0). Applier emits each as a checklist row in the apply report; operator executes by hand.

DateLike.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or full ISO date-time. Bare YYYY-MM-DD in source YAML expands to ISO date-time after YAML→JSON conversion; both forms are accepted.

Platform.description: Board substrate this changeset targets. github_projects is the only applier-supported value in v0.1.x; linear lands alongside plynth's Linear support. Low-level mutation primitives differ by platform; substrate-specific fields nest under a future `platform_specific` block (not present in v0.1.x because the github_projects shape covers all current primitives).
Platform.$comment: When Linear support lands, prefer a discriminated nested block (`linear: { ... }`) over per-field platform discriminators. Keeps the high-level changeset structure (modifications, new_tasks, decisions) substrate-agnostic.

Color.description: GitHub Projects v2 single-select option color enum. Exactly the eight values the GraphQL API accepts.

IssueRef.description: Issue reference. Accepts project-prefixed IDs (e.g., WS-005, PROJ-042) and plain GitHub issue numbers. The board's plynth state file disambiguates.

FieldName.description: Project field name as it appears on the board. Applier resolves the field-ID at apply time. Free-form because v0 supports custom fields, not just Status/Workstream/etc.

OptionValue.description: Option label as written in the changeset. Applier resolves to option-id via tolerant match (exact > prefix > tokenized) and fails loudly if ambiguous. Shorthand (e.g., "Tier 1") matches canonical option names (e.g., "Tier 1 — Visibility"). Null is permitted for explicit "clear this field". Numeric/boolean for non-single-select field types.

Source.description: Provenance of the changeset narrative — what document(s) it translates, when reconciled, why.

document.description: Path or filename of the primary source document (markdown change doc).

reconciliation_date.description: ISO date when this changeset was reconciled from source(s).

origin_date.description: ISO date of the source document itself when single-wave.

origin_dates.description: Multi-wave origin dates when the changeset reconciles more than one source. Keys are wave labels, values are ISO dates.

rationale.description: Operator prose: why this changeset exists, what waves it merges, conflict-resolution rules applied.

supersedes.description: Earlier change documents this changeset replaces. Preserved for traceability; the applier doesn't act on them.

BoardRef.description: Where this changeset applies. Applier validates that --board matches this reference before mutating.

target.description: Host of the board. github.com for public Declaratus/personal; internal GHES instances for internal boards.

owner.description: Organization or user that owns the project.

number.description: ProjectV2 number. "TBD" permitted during authoring; applier rejects "TBD" at --apply time.

name_hint.description: Human-readable project name. Operator-facing only; applier matches by number.

BodyMutation.description: One body-section mutation. Action determines which other fields are required.

section.description: Managed section header in the issue body (e.g., "Acceptance Criteria", "Notes"). Applier creates the section if it doesn't exist rather than failing.

action.description: append: add text under the section. replace_line: substring-match a line and substitute. replace_section: drop existing section content, write new_text. rewrite_section: same as replace_section but signals "this is a periodic consolidation, not a content change" — applier records the prior content in the apply report so the rewrite is auditable.

match.description: Used by action=replace_line. Substring match; applier errors if multiple lines match or no line matches.

with.description: Used by action=replace_line. Replacement line content.

new_text.description: Used by action=replace_section and action=rewrite_section. Full content for the section after the mutation.

BodyMutation.$comment: replace_line uses substring match (not regex) by design — change docs name lines literally, and substring keeps authoring sane. Anchored or regex variants can be added as new action values (replace_line_regex) without breaking the v0.1 shape.

StatusTransition.description: Status field change paired with a modification. Distinct from a field_updates row because the operator wanted to bundle it with body changes and a comment.

to.description: Target Status option name. Must exist on the board after field_options has applied.

from.description: Optional pre-condition. If present, applier verifies current status matches before transitioning and fails otherwise.

Comment.description: Issue comment to append. v0 only supports append (no edit or delete of existing comments).

why.description: Operator prose explaining the change. Not consumed by the applier; surfaced in the apply report for human review.

title.description: Issue title rewrite. Full replacement, not transform — caller writes the literal new title.

body.description: Ordered list of body-section mutations. Applier executes in array order.

decisions_resolved.description: Decision IDs (matching decisions[*].id) this modification resolves. Applier MUST transition each referenced decision to state=resolved if not already, and record the modification's issue+changeset in the decision's resolution trail. Referential integrity: every ID listed here must appear in this changeset's decisions block.

sources.description: Structured citation back to source material — wave label and question/section number. Optional but recommended for multi-wave reconciliations.

Modification.$comment: anyOf enforces that a modification actually mutates something. A bare {issue, why} is rejected — that belongs in source.rationale, not modifications.

NewTask.description: Issue to create. v0 caveat in top-level description: applier defers creation to plynth in v0.1 (emits as pending_external_action target=plynth-create).

requires_external.description: External Dependency field value at creation. "None" if no external dependency.

description.description: Long-form issue body intro before the Scope / Acceptance Criteria sections.

scope.description: Bullet items for the Scope section. Each item becomes one bullet in the rendered body.

acceptance_criteria.description: Bullet items for the Acceptance Criteria section.

dependencies.description: Structured dependency declarations. Applier files native GitHub issue-dependency links for blocked_by and blocks; informs and external are rendered into the body and the External Dependency field respectively.

external.description: Free-form external dependency descriptors (vendor names, upstream project names). Reserved space for v0; v1 may structure into role + name.

sources.description: Structured citation back to source material — wave label and RFC/question/section number. Same shape as Modification.sources; useful when a new task originates from a specific planning artifact.

FieldUpdate.description: One bulk-table assignment. Flat triples are the v0 design. The largest Phase A1 fixture exercised ~135 entries; if 300+ becomes routine in real use, revisit nested-by-issue shape in v0.2.

note.description: Operator prose for this row (e.g., plan-table rationale). Not consumed by the applier; surfaced in the apply report.

derivation_hint.description: How this value was chosen. explicit: source doc named it. default-then-override: applier should warn if operator hasn't reviewed per-row. body-lean: operator inferred from issue body wording. rule-derived: computed from another field. Applier prints a banner when any non-explicit values exist and a final-pass-review hasn't been recorded.

FieldOptionDeclaration.description: Full desired-state for one single-select field's options. Replaces (not merges) — every option that should exist after apply MUST appear in desired_options. Omission deletes (along with item field values).

why.description: Operator prose explaining the option-set change (new states, recolor scheme, etc.).

name.description: Option label. Applier matches existing options by name; unmatched names are created.

description.description: Option description shown in the project UI. Applier preserves existing descriptions when this is omitted.

rationale.description: Operator-facing note explaining color/group choice. Not written to the board.

group.description: Thematic group label used by operator-facing tooling (e.g., grouping ten options into two color-themes). Not written to the board.

migration.description: How to remap existing item values when option names change. Required when desired_options omits a name that exists on the live field.

condition.description: Plain prose describing when this remap applies (operator-readable; not machine-evaluated).

derivation_note.description: Prose explaining migration rules the applier cannot mechanize.

requires_worksheet.description: If true, applier halts after creating new options and emits a CSV worksheet of every item affected. Operator fills in target values and re-runs with --worksheet <path>. Default false.

Decision.description: Decision-register entry. Captures context, options, and current state of a choice the operator is making or has made.

id.description: Stable decision ID. Lowercase, kebab-case. Referenced by Modification.decisions_resolved.

state.description: Controlled state vocabulary. lean-* states signal a working position not yet ratified. Anything decision-specific (which option won) belongs in resolution, not state. resolved implies a resolution string is present.

context.description: Background prose: why this is a decision, what's at stake.

options.description: Labeled alternatives the decision is between.

label.description: Short identifier (A, B, C, or a name).

detail.description: What this option means in practice.

flags.description: Free-form trade-offs or risks attached to the decision. Used when options aren't enumerated as discrete choices but the decision still has named considerations.

affects.description: Issue IDs this decision touches. Cross-references can target any issue in the changeset, whether listed under modifications or field_updates. Applier validates referential integrity.

next_step.description: Concrete action that advances the decision. What happens before the next state transition.

resolution.description: Required when state=resolved. The specific resolution chosen (referencing an option label or a free-form outcome).

PendingExternalAction.description: TODO the applier cannot execute. Emitted as a checklist row in the apply report.

target.description: Free-form target descriptor naming who or what executes the action out-of-band. Common shapes: doc-site (site section to update), inventory-record-store (asset/record system), project-memory (architectural-decisions log), dependencies-map (a diagram or registry), vendor-followup (named contact), plynth-create (issue creation deferred to plynth), board-name (a different project board). v1 may convert to a registered enum per project; v0 leaves free-form.

section.description: Sub-target when relevant (e.g., a doc-site section heading).

record.description: Record identifier when target is a record-store (e.g., an inventory or asset system).

field.description: Field within record when target+record narrow down to a field-level action.

action.description: Operator-readable instruction. Can be multi-line. Applier surfaces verbatim in the apply report.
